entries.52f8c5de2ce49fb0: The medium-term management plan "Challenge Stage Ⅳ", starting in 2025, sets out the basic policy "Master measurement, take on the challenge of understanding, and connect to the world", and aims to expand specialist expertise and the market by leveraging its strengths in manufacturing capability, measurement capability and customer support capability. Its long-term management strategy calls for creating customer value through a "mono → koto → mono" cycle (goods → experiences → goods), in which product functions form the foundation, services add value, and knowledge gained through co-creation with customers is fed back into product development, aiming for sustainable growth. As part of its growth strategy, the company is constructing the "Chubu Linkage Commons", a facility in Toyota City, Aichi Prefecture equipped with automotive test equipment, scheduled to begin operation in September 2027.

entries.8fd0519d811b2f81: The company is a measuring instrument manufacturer, established in 1954 as the limited company Ono Sokki Seisakusho. Its head office is in Nishi-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, and it is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of December 31, 2025, consolidated employees numbered 653, and there are six consolidated subsidiaries, including sales subsidiaries in the United States, Thailand, India and China.
